title: AutoGen Flow number on create
note: Build this in the Power Automate designer. Paste the expressions from the AutoGen Flow dialog after you save the list rule. A direct import is omitted because the SharePoint connection and the target list are chosen per site.

actions.name: Condition
yes: Compose ResetPeriod, LastResetDate, CurrentCount, CounterWidth, CounterToken, FormulaColumns from Config
Compose Rolled using if() so an empty LastResetDate does not format a date
Compose Next = 1 when Rolled, otherwise CurrentCount + 1
Compose Padded from twelve zeros and CounterWidth
Compose CodeStart = Formula with CounterToken and {yyyy}{yy}{MM}{dd}{HH}{mm} replaced from Created
Apply to each split(FormulaColumns, ',') and replace {token} from the trigger item
Update the created item number column with variables('Code')
Update the master row CurrentCount to Next and LastResetDate to Created
